name: M15 EURUSD-GBPUSD relative-dislocation convergence and divergence basket

source_references.citation: Gatev, Goetzmann and Rouwenhorst (2006), Pairs Trading: Performance of a Relative-Value Arbitrage Rule, Review of Financial Studies 19(3), 797-827
source_references.supports: The opened NBER working-paper version tests selected U.S. stock pairs on daily data from 1962-1997 with six-month trading periods, documents convergence profits and material microstructure/cost sensitivity. It does not validate a fixed EURUSD-GBPUSD M15 standardized-return dislocation or 30-60-minute response.

research.evidence_summary: Primary equity pairs evidence motivates relative-price convergence as a falsifiable mechanism but does not transfer the pair, horizon, scale or execution. Both convergence and further-divergence signs are counted.

feasibility.rationale: Uses synchronized OHLC for two declared FX pairs, prior-only robust scales and ATRs, and an atomic two-leg basket. V2 has not confirmed synchronized two-leg or event-level result semantics.

market.base_timeframe: Synchronized M1 aggregated causally to M15
market.session: Weekday pair signals from synchronized completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; both legs exit no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC synchronized for EURUSD and GBPUSD and aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with at least 100 valid observed synchronized M15 closes through t; t-5..t physically contiguous for both pairs
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per symbol per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; any pair defect suppresses pre-entry event
Require identical UTC interval ends for both symbols throughout t-5..t
For each symbol compute observed log returns; robust scale at j is 1.4826 times MAD of 96 returns ending at j, with the median and absolute-deviation median computed mechanically
Compute each symbol's observed-sequence TR and Wilder ATR(96), seeded from first 96 valid TRs and frozen through t-1
Routine elapsed gaps remain in observed indicator history; the synchronized event window itself must be contiguous
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: Atomic two-leg basket entry and cell accounting
V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage per leg
limitations: Opened evidence concerns selected equity pairs and long horizons
EURUSD and GBPUSD are fixed without direct cointegration evidence
Robust-scale and two-standardized-unit choices are original
Two legs accumulate costs and common USD exposure is not perfectly neutral

hypothesis.behavior: A newly extreme difference between EURUSD and GBPUSD four-change returns, standardized by their separate prior-only robust volatilities, may converge or widen further over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: The two European currencies share regional and USD drivers, so a relative dislocation may be temporary; alternatively pair-specific information can make divergence persistent.
works_when: The fixed pair has stable short-horizon relative pricing
One response sign survives both holds and two-leg costs
fails_when: The spread is not stationary or economically matched
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode have positive basket net R normal/doubled
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and both leg contributions are positive
Both cells survive common five-date removal and sample gates

definitions.name: robust_scale
definitions.formula: scale_{s,j}=1.4826*median(|r_i-median(r)|) for the 96 observed log returns ending j
definitions.timing: Current event uses scale_{s,t-1}; prior event uses scale_{s,t-2}; require finite positive

definitions.name: standardized_four_change
definitions.timing: Denominator 2=sqrt(4); each scale excludes the corresponding current return

definitions.name: relative_dislocation
definitions.timing: Both pairs synchronized; require finite values

definitions.name: dislocation_entry
definitions.timing: Known at synchronized t close; D_t nonzero by threshold

definitions.name: foreign_currency_side
definitions.formula: DIVERGENCE: EUR side=direction and GBP side=-direction; CONVERGENCE: EUR side=-direction and GBP side=direction
definitions.timing: EURUSD and GBPUSD pair sides equal their foreign-currency sides

definitions.name: atr96_prior_by_symbol
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) for each symbol through t-1
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal; both require finite positive

entries.long_condition: for pair s: valid synchronized dislocation entry AND foreign_currency_side_s=+1 AND cell has no open pair
entries.short_condition: for pair s: valid synchronized dislocation entry AND foreign_currency_side_s=-1 AND cell has no open pair
entries.signal_time: Synchronized close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Atomically enter EURUSD and GBPUSD at their final synchronized M1 chart/bid closes; V2 applies each leg's resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. No partial pair is permitted. Entry candles cannot trigger stops; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Two simultaneous supported signal-close market orders
restrictions: Cell must be flat across both legs
Both data streams, prior scales, ATRs, costs and sizes must be valid/representable or the cell skips the event
No pyramiding, partial entry or open-pair rebalancing
Persistent abs(D)>=2 cannot retrigger until abs(D) first falls strictly below two and later re-enters
Out-of-window threshold entries are not traded but remain part of prior/current calculations

exits.stop_loss: Each leg uses one frozen symbol ATR: long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-ATR_s; short=signal_close_bid+ATR_s. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit every surviving leg at its synchronized M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid required leg interval in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the entire affected cell; on a valid due bar each leg resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No pair matures after 15:00; a post-entry required-leg defect fails the affected cell rather than retaining a partial estimand

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns one isolated pair portfolio. Both legs size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot at 0.20% chart-stop risk per leg before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.maximum_risk_per_trade: 0.20% current equity per leg before costs
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Exactly two legs and at most 0.40% aggregate initial chart-stop risk per pair per cell
risk.leverage: Require both legs to satisfy V2 size/leverage limits; otherwise skip the entire cell event
risk.concurrent_positions: Within a cell either zero or one two-leg pair; four cells independently track equity, positions and failures

experiment.baseline: four-change robust-standardized absolute dislocation rising through two/two one-ATR legs; CONVERGENCE; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells as event-level pair portfolios and retain full breadth ledger
Report pair events, entered legs, EUR/GBP leg contributions, dislocation sign and UTC-midpoint halves
Double spread, commission and slippage individually on both legs
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London pair dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled basket net R positive
For both cells use eligible synchronized London weekdays including zero-event dates and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026021; center basket lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Require center at least 300 pair events and 600 entered legs; require both EURUSD and GBPUSD net contributions positive in each half
Report zero-scale suppressions, missing-symbol suppressions, threshold sign counts and event concentration
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at every leg fill
Double each component for both legs
benchmarks: Zero pair net R after both-leg costs
Opposite response mode on identical dislocations
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 344 selectable R007-R021 cells, two R008 diagnostics, Gatev-style pair trials, I-20 pair/ratio ideas, R019/R020 cross-symbol baskets, and every named EURUSD-GBPUSD relative-value trial. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family/leg rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds have positive pair net R normal/doubled
Reject if center pair net R is non-positive in either UTC half or either leg contribution is non-positive in either half
Reject if center has fewer than 300 pair events or 600 legs
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell or atomic-pair data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build synchronized valid EURUSD and GBPUSD London M15 bars.
Maintain each symbol's robust 96-return scale and ATR96 causally.
For t-5..t compute prior/current standardized four-change returns and D.
Trigger only abs(D) rising from below two to at least two.
For each flat cell map convergence/divergence to opposite pair sides, validate both sizes/costs, then atomically enter.
From next synchronized M1 process each leg stop before due exit; any required-leg defect fails the cell.
Publish four pair cells, leg/sign contributions and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 synchronized candle, robust-statistic, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: prior abs(D) equality two cannot trigger
D sign maps EUR/GBP legs exactly oppositely
invalid leg size suppresses whole cell pair
each leg stop precedes due exit
adverse gaps use worse executable opens
post-entry defect in a required leg fails whole affected cell
implementation.computational_requirements: One synchronized causal pass over two symbols with four isolated atomic-pair portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 synchronized robust-scale, atomic two-leg, leg-level result and per-leg cost/fill compatibility confirmation
